about: Carve node type to ProseMirror node/mark name, for engines building a Carve <-> ProseMirror bridge. Carve type names are the normative vocabulary from the spec (docs/profiles.md); the ProseMirror names are this package's CarveKit schema. Consumers read this rather than restating the mapping, which is how carve-php once ended up emitting `citation-group` against everyone else's underscores. `pm` is the name CarveKit registers; an optional `accepts` lists further names a bridge should recognize on the way in, for concepts a stock Tiptap extension already spells differently.

heading.notes: level plus authored id, classes, and key/value attributes

code_block.notes: language attr; languageRaw carries the unnormalized info string

list.notes: listType selects; taskList when items carry a task marker

math.notes: inline atom; display attr for the `$$` form

div.notes: carveTabSet/carveTab are the `tabs`/`tab` classes; every other class is carveDiv

admonition.notes: profile vocabulary only: an admonition is a div with a type class

comment.notes: block attr distinguishes %% line comments from fenced comments

mention.notes: carveTag for the `#tag` flavor. `accepts` lists names a bridge should ALSO recognize on the way in that CarveKit does not itself register: `mention` is stock tiptap/extension-mention, and refusing it made a plain editor fail on a concept Carve already models fully.

inline_extension.notes: partial: only media embeds are modeled, via the directive stamped in carveSource

link_reference_definition.notes: atom; label, href and title attrs. Carrying the definition is what lets a `[text][label]` reference keep its spelling

inline_footnote.notes: inline content; the number is a resolution artifact and is not carried

raw_inline.notes: inline atom; content and format attrs

substitution.notes: inline atom; oldText and newText attrs

citation_group.notes: inline atom; raw and integral attrs, plus items whose prefix/locator/suffix are ProseMirror inline arrays

heading_ref.notes: inline atom; target attr. The resolved href is a resolution artifact and is not carried

section.notes: a rendering wrapper: the bridge hoists its children through a carveSection node so the heading and body survive

critic_comment.notes: content is literal, so it rides on a text node under the mark - the same shape `code` uses

span.notes: carries id, class and extra attributes. Stock tiptap/extension-text-style emits `textStyle`, deliberately NOT accepted: it is a carrier mark for color/fontFamily/fontSize, so mapping it here would put presentational attributes into a Carve document. An application that wants that registers `textStyle` itself.

autolink.notes: profile vocabulary only: an autolink is a link whose text is its destination

unmapped.abbreviation_def: abbreviation definitions ride on the doc node's attrs
unmapped.caption_number: numbered captions are a resolution artifact, not editor content
unmapped.raw_text: raw text is the payload of a raw block, not a node an editor holds
unmapped.escaped_text: escaping is a source-level concern; the editor holds the escaped character as text
unmapped.smart_punctuation: smart-typography output is lossy on reparse, so it is not modeled
unmapped.soft_break: a soft break is whitespace in the ProseMirror model

_provenance.refresh: copy the file from carve-grammars and update commit; the schema-map test asserts every AST type still has a decision
